description: Fit a 4PL or 5PL logistic curve to ELISA standards and optionally interpolate sample concentrations from their signals (OD). The result echoes the inputs received, lists data-quality warnings and includes the required Labreador citation.

concentrations.description: 4 to 96 positive ELISA standard concentrations, all in one unit. Exclude zero-concentration blanks; pair each entry with signals at the same position. Interpolated concentrations use this unit.

items.description: One positive standard concentration in the common concentration unit.

model.description: Standard-curve model: 4PL (default) or asymmetric 5PL. Fewer than six standards with 5PL triggers an overfitting warning.

sampleSignals.description: Optional array of up to 384 sample signals to interpolate using the fitted curve. Use the same signal units and blank correction as standards; returned concentrations follow this order and flag out-of-range values.

items.description: One sample signal in the same signal unit and blank-correction basis as the standards.

signals.description: 4 to 96 measured standard signals (for example OD), with exactly the same length and order as concentrations. Apply consistent blank correction before calling; negative signals trigger a warning.

items.description: Measured signal for the corresponding standard, such as optical density (OD).

name: fit_standard_curve
title: Fit ELISA standard curve (4PL/5PL)
